text:
Maria L: Heads-up — opened a Terraform plan changing the HPA target for the inference namespace from 60% -> 50% and adding an annotation `autoscaling.redwood.com/rollout=canary`. Looking for a quick safety check before merge.

Aj Patel: pinging @Simon K and @Rachael for canary/window questions. Why the lower CPU target?

Maria L: We saw tail latency spikes during burst tests; lowering target helps HPA scale earlier. Also adding a small `scaleDownDelaySeconds` tweak in the Karpenter provisioner for the inference pool. TF snippet in PR:```hcl
resource "kubernetes_horizontal_pod_autoscaler" "inference" {
  metadata {
    name = "inference-hpa"
    namespace = "inference"
    annotations = {
      "autoscaling.redwood.com/rollout" = "canary"
    }
  }
  spec {
    scale_target_ref {
      kind = "Deployment"
      name = "inference-deploy"
    }
    min_replicas = 2
    max_replicas = 50
    target_cpu_utilization_percentage = 50
  }
}
```

Simon K: Quick glance — TF looks sane. Question: how does this interact with VPA? We have a VPA configured as recommendation-only for these pods.

Maria L: VPA is recommendation-only and won't evict on its own. This HPA change should be compatible. VPA snippet for context:```yaml
apiVersion: autoscaling.k8s.io/v1
kind: VerticalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: inference-vpa
  namespace: inference
spec:
  targetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: inference-deploy
  updatePolicy:
    updateMode: "Off" # recommendations only
  resourcePolicy:
    containerPolicies:
    - containerName: "model"
      controlledResources: ["cpu","memory"]
```

Rachael (SRE): What's the canary plan (duration + metrics)? Also want a rollback runbook.

Maria L: Canary plan: label 10% of inference pods with `autoscale-rollout=canary` in preprod, run for 2 hours. Watch metrics: `queue_latency_p95`, `hpa_replicas`, `karpenter_provisioner_pending_nodes`. Commands to watch:```bash
# watch replicas and HPA status
kubectl -n inference get hpa inference-hpa -o wide
# promql examples
queue_latency_p95{job="inference"}
hpa_target_utilization_percent{hpa="inference-hpa"}
```
If anything looks off, we'll flip the label or revert the TF change.

Vinh: PR notes mention moving the metrics exporter secret from `secret/inference-metrics` -> `secret/metrics-readonly`. Who owns the rotation and Vault sync?

Maria L: That secret path change is in my PR — metrics exporter only needs readonly token. @Aj, can you update the vault-sync TF module to include the new path? Also need to update bootstrap/CI env var: `METRICS_SECRET_PATH=secret/metrics-readonly`.

Aj Patel: On it — will add vault-sync change and queue a follow-up PR. I'll plan to run the apply in a low-traffic window (overnight) after we confirm canary looks stable.

deploy-bot: terraform plan: succeeded in staging — 3 changes (2 additions, 1 modification).

Simon K: One more flag: I noticed Karpenter consolidation TTL in the provisioner changed from 300s -> 180s in the branch. That's aggressive for spot churn — is that only for the inference provisioner?

Maria L: Yes, only for `inference-provisioner`. Reason: want faster drain of short-lived burst nodes to free capacity. We kept general provisioner TTL unchanged. PodDisruptionBudgets for model pods remain at 5m to avoid evict flapping.

Rachael (SRE): :thumbsup: Approving the canary as long as you add a clear rollback step in the PR description (flip `autoscale-rollout` label to `off` and revert TF). Also confirm alert thresholds we'll watch.

Maria L: Will add rollback steps + alert list to the PR and wait for Aj's vault-sync update. Will merge after 2h of stable metrics in preprod. Thanks all for the quick checks!
